So let’s ask the people who know it best: What’s ONE thing about Algeria you wish the rest of the world understood? 🇩🇿 Tell us below — especially if you’re Algerian or part of the diaspora. And if there’s someone in your DMs who only knows the Algeria they’ve seen from afar, send them this. Some places impress you. Algeria stays with you. Not travel.
